Name: DDFC Scaler
Author: SerDakota
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]I got tired of having to mess with and figure out good scaling options in JSON format so I said screw it and wrote a DLL to handle it. Basically with DDFC Scaler and GMCM installed you will find a new config for DDFC Scaler. [/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]When set to default nothing happens, the portraits and dialogue box will look and function as the original mod author intended. However setting the dropdown to "Left" or "TopRight" will change the layout of both. 
[/color]
All three settings SHOULD auto scale portraits based on your screen resolution to fill a predetermined amount of your screen. Note that this is considering the ENTIRE png being loaded, not just the portrait thats visible.

[color=#d4d4d8]Left centers the Portrait on the left side of the screen, with the dialogue on the right side of the screen.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]TopRight extends the dialouge box to take up the majority of the bottom of the screen and places the portrait ontop of the dialogue box on the right side of said box. 

Included are a horizontal and vertical offset to help tweak the portraits as desired in additional to multiple additional scaling options for the portrait that work as size multipliers. These are universal settings.

[/color]Planned Features:
Animation Support if I can figure it out.
Refining the scaling and positioning if its needed/required.

Thats about it, its fairly simple in theory which is kind of the point so if there is a feature you think would be a good addition let me know. 

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Dialogue Display Framework Continued and Generic Mod Config Menu are needed for it to function. You also must have a compatible JSON file in your Portrait nod, more info in the article. [/color]

Manifest.Name: DDFC Scaler
Manifest.Description: Viewport-aware scaling layer for Dialogue Display Framework Continued. Automatically calculates portrait size, position, and all dialogue UI element positions relative to the active UI viewport, and writes them into DDFC before it renders.
Manifest.Author: dakot
